title: Platonish
cn: 第 9 集 · 柏拉图式
novel:
In a [[flashback|flashback]] to earlier that year, the gang sat at their usual booth in MacLaren's bar. They [[pondered|ponder]] the complicated love [[triangle|triangle]] between Ted, Robin, and Barney. Ted insisted that his relationship with Robin was purely [[platonic|platonic]], but his friends were not convinced.

Lily and Robin made a bet with Barney. They [[challenged|challenge]] him to [[approach|approach]] a woman at the bar and get her phone number. Barney, who was always [[confident|confident]], accepted the [[dare|dare]] without hesitation.

Barney tried his usual [[techniques|technique]] to impress the woman, but she was not interested. She [[refused|refuse]] to give him her number. This was [[unusual|unusual]] for Barney, who rarely failed at picking up women.

Lily told Barney to try being [[genuine|genuine]] instead of using his normal tricks. Barney [[struggled|struggle]] with this advice. He was not used to being honest about his feelings with strangers.

Robin watched from across the bar and felt [[conflicted|conflict]] about her own feelings. She wondered if she was making the right choice by marrying Barney. She still cared about Ted, but she loved Barney in a different way.

Barney eventually [[abandoned|abandon]] his attempts to get the phone number. He sat back down with his friends and told them that he did not need to pick up women anymore because he was getting married. This [[surprised|surprise]] everyone, including Barney himself.

The flashback ended with the group toasting to the future. Ted raised his glass and said he was happy for Robin and Barney. Deep down, however, he still carried a small flame for Robin that he could not completely [[extinguish|extinguish]].

flashback.en: The movie used a flashback to show the past.

triangle.en: They were caught in a love triangle.

challenge.en: She challenged him to try harder.

confident.en: She felt confident about the test.

dare.en: He took the dare without fear.

technique.en: She learned a new painting technique.

refuse.en: He refused to answer the question.

unusual.en: It was unusual for him to be late.

conflict.en: She felt conflicted about the choice.
